edits.blurHint: Softens the whole picture. Useful for hiding compression, at the cost of sharpness.
edits.brightnessHint: Lightens or darkens the whole picture evenly. Too much flattens shadows and blows out highlights.
edits.contrastHint: Pushes lights and darks away from the midtones. Too much loses detail at both ends.
edits.denoiseHint: Removes grain and speckle. Too much erases fine texture along with the noise.
edits.gammaHint: Lifts the midtones without moving black or white. Useful when a shot looks dark but is not underexposed.
edits.grainHint: Adds grain for a film-like texture. Also hides banding in skies and gradients.
edits.hue_degreesHint: Rotates every colour around the wheel. Small values fix a colour cast; large ones swap the colours.
edits.notInLivePreview: Some active settings are not in the moving preview — only in the exported file.
edits.saturationHint: Deepens or drains the colours. Too much turns skin orange.
edits.sharpnessHint: Emphasises edges to suggest focus. Too much draws bright halos around them.
